description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'Log' for logging purposes in an Android environment. It acts as a wrapper around Android's native Log class and facilitates logging by chaining LogNode instances, providing methods for various log levels and message formatting.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Utility class for handling logging operations, providing static methods to log messages at different priority levels and manage LogNode chaining.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message to the current LogNode.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message or throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message or throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assertion message or throwable.
